answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake in a crystal-clear public escrow, released only after honest work. New identities start with no reputation and must finish low-value verifiable tasks before larger ones, so each fake identity must be funded separately. A slashed credential cannot be recycled: a relic identity stays marked after cheating and cannot simply be renamed. Like water carving karst, repeated honest work gradually earns wider trust, while a sybil farm pays per identity more than capped low-trust work can return.
